local WHITESPACE = " \n" local PUNCTUATION = "!\"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\\]^_`{|}~" local TOC_MARKER = "\0toc\0" local HTML_ESCAPES = { ["&"] = "&", ["<"] = "<", [">"] = ">", ['"'] = """ } local ALERT_TYPES = { NOTE = true, TIP = true, IMPORTANT = true, WARNING = true, CAUTION = true } local function starts(text, prefix, at) at = at or 1 return text:sub(at, at + #prefix - 1) == prefix end local function contains(text, character) return character ~= "" and text:find(character, 1, true) ~= nil end local function trim(text) return (text:gsub("^ +", ""):gsub(" +$", "")) end local function escape(text) return (text:gsub('[&<>"]', HTML_ESCAPES)) end local function strip_tags(text) return (text:gsub("<[^>]*>", "")) end local function normalize(text) return (text:lower():gsub("[ \n]+", " "):gsub("^ ", ""):gsub(" $", "")) end local function skip_space(text, at) while at <= #text and contains(WHITESPACE, text:sub(at, at)) do at = at + 1 end return at end local function escaped_read(text, at, stops) local parts = {} while at <= #text and not contains(stops, text:sub(at, at)) do if text:sub(at, at) == "\\" and contains(PUNCTUATION, text:sub(at + 1, at + 1)) then at = at + 1 end parts[#parts + 1] = text:sub(at, at) at = at + 1 end return table.concat(parts), at end local function run_end(text, at) local stop = at + 1 while stop <= #text and text:sub(stop, stop) == text:sub(at, at) do stop = stop + 1 end return stop end local function backtick_closer(text, at, length) while at <= #text do at = text:find("`", at, true) if not at then return nil end local stop = run_end(text, at) if stop - at == length then return at end at = stop end end local function closing_bracket(text, at) local depth = 0 while at <= #text do local character = text:sub(at, at) if character == "\\" then at = at + 2 elseif character == "`" then local stop = run_end(text, at) local close = backtick_closer(text, stop, stop - at) at = close and close + stop - at or stop else if character == "[" then depth = depth + 1 elseif character == "]" then depth = depth - 1 if depth == 0 then return at end end at = at + 1 end end end local function opening_fence(line) if not contains("`~", line:sub(1, 1)) then return nil end local stop = run_end(line, 1) if stop < 4 then return nil end local info = trim(line:sub(stop)) if line:sub(1, 1) == "`" and contains(info, "`") then return nil end return line:sub(1, stop - 1), info end local function atx_heading(line) local hashes = line:match("^(#+)") if not hashes or #hashes > 6 or (#line > #hashes and line:sub(#hashes + 1, #hashes + 1) ~= " ") then return nil end local text = trim(line:sub(#hashes + 1)) local stripped = text:gsub("#+$", "") if stripped == "" or stripped:sub(-1) == " " then text = trim(stripped) end return { kind = "heading", number = #hashes, text = text } end local function is_rule(line) local compact = line:gsub(" ", "") return #compact >= 3 and contains("-*_", compact:sub(1, 1)) and compact == compact:sub(1, 1):rep(#compact) end local function list_marker(line) if is_rule(line) then return nil end local marker, spaces, content = line:match("^([%-%*+])( +)(.*)$") if marker then return { marker = marker, ordered = false, number = 1, content = content } end local digits digits, marker, spaces, content = line:match("^(%d+)([%.%)])( +)(.*)$") if digits and #digits <= 9 then return { marker = marker, ordered = true, number = tonumber(digits), content = content } end end local function interrupts(line) if line == "" or starts(line, " ") then return false end return opening_fence(line) ~= nil or atx_heading(line) ~= nil or is_rule(line) or starts(line, ">") or list_marker(line) ~= nil end local function split_cells(line) local text = trim(line) if starts(text, "|") then text = text:sub(2) end local cells, parts, at, final_separator = {}, {}, 1, false while at <= #text do local character = text:sub(at, at) final_separator = false if character == "\\" and at < #text then local following = text:sub(at + 1, at + 1) parts[#parts + 1] = following == "|" and "|" or "\\" .. following at = at + 2 elseif character == "|" then cells[#cells + 1] = trim(table.concat(parts)) parts, final_separator, at = {}, true, at + 1 else parts[#parts + 1], at = character, at + 1 end end if not final_separator then cells[#cells + 1] = trim(table.concat(parts)) end return cells end local Parser = {} Parser.__index = Parser function Parser:definition(line) local name, body = line:match("^%[%^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)%]:(.*)$") if name and trim(body) ~= "" then name = name:lower() if self.footnotes[name] == nil then self.footnotes[name] = trim(body) end return true end if not starts(line, "[") then return false end local close = line:find("]", 1, true) if not close or line:sub(close + 1, close + 1) ~= ":" then return false end local label = line:sub(2, close - 1) if contains(label, "[") or trim(label) == "" or starts(label, "^") then return false end local url, stop = escaped_read(line, skip_space(line, close + 2), " ") if url == "" then return false end local at, title = skip_space(line, stop), nil if at <= #line then local quote = line:sub(at, at) if at == stop or not contains("\"'", quote) then return false end local finish title, finish = escaped_read(line, at + 1, quote) if finish ~= #line then return false end end name = normalize(label) if self.references[name] == nil then self.references[name] = { url = url, title = title } end return true end function Parser:parse(lines) local blocks, at = {}, 1 while at <= #lines do local line, block = lines[at], nil if line == "" then at = at + 1 elseif starts(line, " ") then local stop = at while stop <= #lines and (lines[stop] == "" or starts(lines[stop], " ")) do stop = stop + 1 end while lines[stop - 1] == "" do stop = stop - 1 end block = { kind = "code", text = "", lines = {} } while at < stop do block.lines[#block.lines + 1] = lines[at] == "" and "" or lines[at]:sub(5) at = at + 1 end else if not starts(line, " ") then local fence, info = opening_fence(line) local heading = atx_heading(line) local marker = list_marker(line) if fence then block = { kind = "code", text = info:match("^[^ ]*") or "", lines = {} } at = at + 1 while at <= #lines do local row = lines[at] at = at + 1 if #row >= #fence and row == fence:sub(1, 1):rep(#row) then break end block.lines[#block.lines + 1] = row end elseif heading then block, at = heading, at + 1 elseif is_rule(line) then block, at = { kind = "rule" }, at + 1 elseif starts(line, ">") then local content = {} while at <= #lines and starts(lines[at], ">") do local row = lines[at]:sub(2) if starts(row, " ") then row = row:sub(2) end content[#content + 1], at = row, at + 1 end block = { kind = "quote" } local alert = content[1]:match("^%[!(%u+)%]$") if ALERT_TYPES[alert] then block.kind, block.text = "alert", alert; table.remove(content, 1) end block.children = self:parse(content) elseif marker then block = { kind = "list", ordered = marker.ordered, number = marker.number, items = {} } local kind = marker.marker while true do local content = { marker.content } at = at + 1 while at <= #lines and starts(lines[at], " ") do content[#content + 1], at = lines[at]:sub(3), at + 1 end block.items[#block.items + 1] = self:parse(content) local following = at while following <= #lines and lines[following] == "" do following = following + 1 end marker = following <= #lines and list_marker(lines[following]) or nil if not marker or marker.marker ~= kind or marker.ordered ~= block.ordered then break end at = following end elseif self:definition(line) then at = at + 1; block = false elseif at < #lines and contains(line, "|") and contains(lines[at + 1], "|") then local header, delimiters = split_cells(line), split_cells(lines[at + 1]) local valid = #header == #delimiters for _, cell in ipairs(delimiters) do if not cell:match("^:?-+:?$") then valid = false end end if valid then block = { kind = "table", lines = header, alignments = {}, rows = {} } for index, cell in ipairs(delimiters) do local left, right = starts(cell, ":"), cell:sub(-1) == ":" block.alignments[index] = left and (right and "center" or "left") or (right and "right" or "") end at = at + 2 while at <= #lines and lines[at] ~= "" and contains(lines[at], "|") do local cells, row = split_cells(lines[at]), {} for index = 1, #delimiters do row[index] = cells[index] or "" end block.rows[#block.rows + 1], at = row, at + 1 end end end end if block == nil then local text, level = { (line:gsub("^ +", "")) }, nil at = at + 1 while at <= #lines and lines[at] ~= "" do local row = lines[at] if row:match("^===+$") or row:match("^%-%-%-+$") then level, at = starts(row, "=") and 1 or 2, at + 1 break end if interrupts(row) then break end text[#text + 1], at = row:gsub("^ +", ""), at + 1 end local combined = table.concat(text, "\n") block = { kind = level and "heading" or (combined == "[TOC]" and "toc" or "paragraph"), text = combined, number = level } end end if block then blocks[#blocks + 1] = block end end return blocks end local function emphasis(pieces, start, stop) local parts, at = {}, start while at <= stop do local piece = pieces[at] if type(piece) == "string" then parts[#parts + 1] = piece else local close if piece.open then for following = at + 1, stop do local other = pieces[following] if type(other) == "table" and other.character == piece.character and other.length == piece.length and other.close then close = following; break end end end if close then local opening, closing = "", "" if piece.character ~= "~" then if piece.length == 1 then opening, closing = "", "" elseif piece.length == 2 then opening, closing = "", "" else opening, closing = "", "" end end parts[#parts + 1] = opening .. emphasis(pieces, at + 1, close - 1) .. closing at = close else parts[#parts + 1] = piece.character:rep(piece.length) end end at = at + 1 end return table.concat(parts) end local function email(text) local local_part, domain = text:match("^([^@]+)@([^@]+)$") if not local_part or not local_part:match("^[A-Za-z0-9%.+_-]+$") then return false end local parts = 0 for part in (domain .. "."):gmatch("(.-)%.") do if not part:match("^[A-Za-z0-9-]+$") then return false end parts = parts + 1 end return parts >= 2 end local Renderer = {} Renderer.__index = Renderer function Renderer:destination(text, at, label) if text:sub(at, at) == "[" then local close = text:find("]", at + 1, true) if close then local key = text:sub(at + 1, close - 1) if not contains(key, "[") then local reference = self.references[normalize(key == "" and label or key)] if not reference then return nil end return reference, close + 1 end end elseif text:sub(at, at) == "(" then local url, stop = escaped_read(text, skip_space(text, at + 1), " \n)") local following, title, valid = skip_space(text, stop), nil, true local quote = text:sub(following, following) if following > stop and contains("\"'", quote) then local finish title, finish = escaped_read(text, following + 1, quote) if finish > #text then valid = false else following = skip_space(text, finish + 1) end end if valid and text:sub(following, following) == ")" then return { url = url, title = title }, following + 1 end end local reference = self.references[normalize(label)] if reference then return reference, at end end local function reference_id(number, count) return "fnref-" .. number .. (count > 1 and "-" .. count or "") end function Renderer:footnote_reference(name) local number = self.footnote_numbers[name] if not number then number = #self.footnote_names + 1 self.footnote_numbers[name], self.footnote_names[number], self.footnote_counts[number] = number, name, 0 end self.footnote_counts[number] = self.footnote_counts[number] + 1 return '' .. number .. '' end function Renderer:bracket(text, at, links, notes) if links and notes and starts(text, "[^", at) then local close = text:find("]", at + 2, true) if close then local name = text:sub(at + 2, close - 1):lower() if self.footnotes[name] then return self:footnote_reference(name), close + 1 end end end local image = text:sub(at, at) == "!" if not image and not links then return nil end local opening = image and at + 1 or at local closing = closing_bracket(text, opening) if not closing then return nil end local label = text:sub(opening + 1, closing - 1) local reference, stop = self:destination(text, closing + 1, label) if not reference then return nil end local content = self:inline(label, false, false) local title = reference.title and ' title="' .. escape(reference.title) .. '"' or "" if image then return '', stop end return '' .. content .. '', stop end function Renderer:next_piece(text, at, links, notes) local character, following = text:sub(at, at), text:sub(at + 1, at + 1) if character == "\\" then if contains(PUNCTUATION, following) then return escape(following), at + 2 end if following == "\n" then return "
\n", at + 2 end return "\\", at + 1 end if character == "`" then local stop = run_end(text, at) local close = backtick_closer(text, stop, stop - at) if not close then return text:sub(at, stop - 1), stop end local code = text:sub(stop, close - 1):gsub("\n", " ") if starts(code, " ") and code:sub(-1) == " " and code:find("[^ ]") then code = code:sub(2, -2) end return "" .. escape(code) .. "", close + stop - at end if links and character == "<" then local close = text:find(">", at + 1, true) if close then local target, href = text:sub(at + 1, close - 1), nil if not target:find("[ \n<]") and ((starts(target, "http://") and #target > 7) or (starts(target, "https://") and #target > 8)) then href = target elseif email(target) then href = "mailto:" .. target end if href then return '' .. escape(target) .. '', close + 1 end end end if links and (starts(text, "http://", at) or starts(text, "https://", at)) and (at == 1 or contains(" \n*_~(", text:sub(at - 1, at - 1))) then local stop = at while stop <= #text and not contains(" \n<", text:sub(stop, stop)) do stop = stop + 1 end while stop > at and contains(".,:;!?*_~)", text:sub(stop - 1, stop - 1)) do stop = stop - 1 end local url = text:sub(at, stop - 1) if url ~= "http://" and url ~= "https://" then local escaped = escape(url) return '' .. escaped .. '', stop end end if character == "[" or (character == "!" and following == "[") then local html, stop = self:bracket(text, at, links, notes) return html or character, stop or at + 1 end if contains("*_~", character) then local stop = run_end(text, at) local length = stop - at local before = at == 1 and " " or text:sub(at - 1, at - 1) local after = stop > #text and " " or text:sub(stop, stop) local can_open, can_close = not contains(WHITESPACE, after), not contains(WHITESPACE, before) if character == "_" and before:match("^[A-Za-z0-9]$") and after:match("^[A-Za-z0-9]$") then can_open, can_close = false, false end if (character ~= "~" and length <= 3) or (character == "~" and length == 2) then return { character = character, length = length, open = can_open, close = can_close }, stop end return character:rep(length), stop end return escape(character), at + 1 end function Renderer:inline(text, links, notes) local pieces, at = {}, 1 while at <= #text do local piece piece, at = self:next_piece(text, at, links, notes) pieces[#pieces + 1] = piece end return emphasis(pieces, 1, #pieces) end function Renderer:blocks(blocks) local parts = {} for _, block in ipairs(blocks) do parts[#parts + 1] = self:render(block) .. "\n" end return table.concat(parts) end function Renderer:heading(level, text) local identifier, start = nil, nil local at = 1 while true do local found = text:find(" {#", at, true) if not found then break end start, at = found, found + 1 end if text:sub(-1) == "}" and start then local candidate = text:sub(start + 3, -2) if candidate:match("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$") then identifier, text = candidate, (text:sub(1, start - 1):gsub(" +$", "")) end end if not identifier then local base = text:lower():gsub("[^a-z0-9_ \n-]", ""):gsub("[ \n]", "-") if base == "" then base = "heading" end identifier = base local suffix = 1 while self.used_ids[identifier] do identifier, suffix = base .. "-" .. suffix, suffix + 1 end end self.used_ids[identifier] = true local html = self:inline(text, true, true) self.headings[#self.headings + 1] = { level = level, id = identifier, label = strip_tags(html), children = {} } return '' .. html .. '' end function Renderer:item(blocks) local parts, newline = { "
  • " }, false for index, block in ipairs(blocks) do if block.kind == "paragraph" then local text = block.text if index == 1 and #text > 4 and (starts(text, "[ ] ") or starts(text, "[x] ") or starts(text, "[X] ")) then parts[#parts + 1] = text:sub(2, 2) == " " and ' ' or ' ' text = text:sub(5) end local html = self:inline(text, true, true) parts[#parts + 1] = html if html ~= "" then newline = html:sub(-1) == "\n" end else if not newline then parts[#parts + 1] = "\n" end parts[#parts + 1], newline = self:render(block) .. "\n", true end end parts[#parts + 1] = "
    • " return table.concat(parts) end function Renderer:table_cells(tag, block, cells) local parts = {} for index, cell in ipairs(cells) do local alignment = block.alignments[index] local style = alignment ~= "" and ' style="text-align:' .. alignment .. '"' or "" parts[#parts + 1] = '<' .. tag .. style .. '>' .. self:inline(cell, true, true) .. '\n' end return table.concat(parts) end function Renderer:render(block) local kind = block.kind if kind == "heading" then return self:heading(block.number, block.text) elseif kind == "paragraph" then return "

    " .. self:inline(block.text, true, true) .. "

    " elseif kind == "rule" then return "
    " elseif kind == "code" then local attribute = block.text ~= "" and ' class="language-' .. escape(block.text) .. '"' or "" local parts = { "
    " }
    for _, line in ipairs(block.lines) do parts[#parts + 1] = escape(line) .. "\n" end
    parts[#parts + 1] = "
    " return table.concat(parts) elseif kind == "quote" then return "
    \n" .. self:blocks(block.children) .. "
    " elseif kind == "alert" then local name = block.text:lower() local title = name:sub(1, 1):upper() .. name:sub(2) return '
    \n

    ' .. title .. '

    \n' .. self:blocks(block.children) .. '
    ' elseif kind == "list" then local tag = block.ordered and "ol" or "ul" local attribute = block.ordered and block.number ~= 1 and ' start="' .. block.number .. '"' or "" local parts = { '<' .. tag .. attribute .. '>\n' } for _, item in ipairs(block.items) do parts[#parts + 1] = self:item(item) .. "\n" end parts[#parts + 1] = '' return table.concat(parts) elseif kind == "table" then local parts = { "\n\n\n", self:table_cells("th", block, block.lines), "\n\n" } if #block.rows > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "\n" for _, row in ipairs(block.rows) do parts[#parts + 1] = "\n" .. self:table_cells("td", block, row) .. "\n" end parts[#parts + 1] = "\n" end parts[#parts + 1] = "
    " return table.concat(parts) elseif kind == "toc" then return TOC_MARKER end end local function toc_list(entries) local parts = { "
      \n" } for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do parts[#parts + 1] = '
    • ' .. entry.label .. '' if #entry.children > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "\n" .. toc_list(entry.children) .. "\n" end parts[#parts + 1] = "
      • \n" end parts[#parts + 1] = "
    " return table.concat(parts) end function Renderer:toc() if #self.headings == 0 then return '
    \n
    ' end local roots, parents = {}, {} for _, heading in ipairs(self.headings) do while #parents > 0 and parents[#parents].level >= heading.level do table.remove(parents) end local siblings = #parents > 0 and parents[#parents].children or roots siblings[#siblings + 1], parents[#parents + 1] = heading, heading end return '
    \n' .. toc_list(roots) .. '\n
    ' end function Renderer:footnote_list() local parts = { '
    \n
      \n' } for number, name in ipairs(self.footnote_names) do parts[#parts + 1] = '
    1. ' .. self:inline(self.footnotes[name], true, false) for count = 1, self.footnote_counts[number] do parts[#parts + 1] = ' ↩' end parts[#parts + 1] = '
      2. \n' end parts[#parts + 1] = '
    \n
    \n' return table.concat(parts) end local function main() local lines = {} for line in io.lines() do if line == "@@END@@" then break end lines[#lines + 1] = line end local parser = setmetatable({ references = {}, footnotes = {} }, Parser) local blocks = parser:parse(lines) local renderer = setmetatable({ references = parser.references, footnotes = parser.footnotes, used_ids = {}, headings = {}, footnote_numbers = {}, footnote_names = {}, footnote_counts = {}, }, Renderer) local html = renderer:blocks(blocks) local toc = renderer:toc() local parts, at = {}, 1 while true do local found = html:find(TOC_MARKER, at, true) if not found then parts[#parts + 1] = html:sub(at); break end parts[#parts + 1], parts[#parts + 2], at = html:sub(at, found - 1), toc, found + #TOC_MARKER end if #renderer.footnote_names > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = renderer:footnote_list() end io.write(table.concat(parts)) end main()
